Improved prompt:

Generate a high-resolution, photorealistic digital artwork based on the provided portrait photograph of an African youth. The artwork should depict him as the central figure in a cutting-edge music streaming environment, showcasing his confident and relaxed demeanor in a visually arresting, symmetrical composition that evokes the cinematic style of high-end fashion spreads.

The artwork must preserve his facial features, skin tone, and hair texture with absolute fidelity to the original photograph. His eyes are wide open, looking directly ahead with a gentle yet assured expression, his gaze capturing the viewer's attention.

The camera angle is set at face-level, straight-on, ensuring his full face is clearly visible and prominently featured. He is seated at the center of the frame, his body relaxed yet radiating a strong, confident presence. His legs are naturally spread, feet planted on the floor, and his hands rest easily on his thighs.

His attire is a stylish combination of contemporary streetwear and high-fashion elements. He wears an oversized top in a deep, matte black or dark olive green color, cut with modern streetwear proportions. The pants are slim-fit cargo trousers in a complementary shade, with contemporary details like zippered pockets and sleek, athletic cut. His footwear is a pair of premium sneakers with a high-fashion aesthetic, featuring bold, clean lines and a signature style that complements his outfit.

The central prop is a pair of premium over-ear headphones, designed to look like a high-end, futuristic model with sleek lines and modern materials. The headphones are positioned on his head, the earpads just touching his ears, and the band resting comfortably across his forehead.

Behind him, the focal point of the scene is a massive, high-resolution digital display wall with a user interface inspired by Spotify. The display features a grid of album covers, playlists, and interactive elements rendered in a cool, neon green and black color palette that complements the overall scene.

The key visual effect is the emergence of dynamic musical elements from the area around his headphones and head. Glowing music notes, holographic equalizers, treble clef symbols, and luminous sound waves emanate from his head, swirling and coalescing into a circular, energy-filled aura that gives the impression of music physically manifesting around him.

The lighting is designed to be cinematic and immersive, with soft shadows and a play of highlights that emphasize his features and the futuristic details of the scene. The textures are rendered in a photorealistic style, with the materials of his clothing, the digital display, and the furniture all appearing tactile and believable.

The artwork should evoke the feeling of a high-end fashion or lifestyle editorial spread, with a sense of style, sophistication, and aspirational luxury. It should be a visually striking image that showcases the subject's charisma and the cutting-edge nature of the streaming technology he represents.

Please deliver the artwork as a high-resolution digital file in a format suitable for professional printing or display, with a color profile that ensures accurate reproduction across various media.
